Rescue teams, including the National Disaster Response Force and Coast Guard, are ready to assist in vulnerable areas. Meanwhile, Andhra Pradesh is also preparing for the storm with designated alerts for various districts.

stories.title: California facility turns 1,000 tons of daily organic waste into renewable gas
Canadian businessman’s $30 million transfers to wife’s caregiver face new trial over alleged gifts
stories.summary: In a gripping legal battle, a wealthy businessman made a staggering transfer of over $30 million to a caregiver for his ailing wife. Following his passing, the estate argues these transfers were investments, not gifts. The Ontario Court of Appeal has mandated a retrial to reevaluate evidence and the burden of proof, with handwritten notes possibly illuminating the deceased's true intentions.

stories.title: Man once given a home for Christmas now leads charity delivering 29,000 Thanksgiving meals
stories.summary: Rob Adams, a childhood homelessness survivor, started Thanksgiving Heroes to assist struggling families. Since its launch, the charity has provided more than 29,000 meals in nine U.S. cities. Through collaborations and dedicated volunteers, the organization alleviates the financial strain of Thanksgiving for families. Adams' own experiences fuel his drive to give back, fostering a spirit of community as Thanksgiving Heroes continues to grow.

stories.title: 3 killed as minibus plunges into 100-foot gorge on Kodaikanal-Palani Ghat Road
stories.summary: Three people were killed, and several others were injured after a minibus carrying 24 passengers plunged into a 100-foot-deep gorge near Savarikkadu on the Kodaikanal–Ghat Road in Dindigul district. The passengers were returning from a wedding function in Kodaikanal. Rescue teams rushed to the spot and shifted the injured to nearby hospitals.

stories.title: SC: Assess buyer's liability before home loan recovery
California’s artificial beaver dams help 7,000 young salmon survive drought
Virginia court rules on lakeside home disputed by widow and her late husband's children
stories.summary: A complex legal battle unfolded over a lakeside property in Virginia involving a widow and the children of her deceased husband. The court has decided that the widow retains a fifty percent ownership stake, while her husband’s children will inherit the remaining half. This ruling reversed a prior decision and provided clarity on property rights, paving the way for future partition proceedings while maintaining the widow's current living situation.

stories.title: Rupert Grint wins approval to build 15 homes on former £6 million estate
stories.summary: Rupert Grint has successfully secured planning permission to create an eco-village at his Kimpton Grange estate in Hertfordshire. This sustainable project will feature six apartments, nine additional homes, a public park, and contribute to local infrastructure improvements, particularly for schools. Earlier concerns from residents regarding wildlife preservation have been addressed, showcasing Grint's commitment to balancing development with environmental care, marking a departure from his previous intent to sell the estate.

stories.title: Partner Loan Remains Payable: Davis forgave family debts; Schriefer’s loan stays due
stories.summary: The estate of Clive Davis, valued at over $50 million at the time of his passing in June, highlights a complex legacy. His will notably forgives the debts of several individuals while specifically excluding his long-time partner Greg Schriefer from such leniency. After the will was admitted to probate, Davis' impressive Manhattan residence hit the market, adding to his extensive real estate and personal property portfolio.

stories.title: Archaeological Experience Pavilion at Purana Qila to bring alive India's civilisational journey through layers of excavations
AERB approves first approach to criticality for RAPP-8 in Rajasthan
UNFPA puts India's population at 1.47 billion in 2026, calls for investment in 'youth dividend'
stories.summary: The UNFPA report forecasts that India's population could reach 1.7 billion by 2066. Currently, over 25% of Indians are aged 10 to 24, showcasing a substantial youth presence. This necessitates urgent investments in youth services and reproductive health to fulfill their future aspirations. Despite economic concerns, young individuals exhibit remarkable optimism, reflecting evolving societal norms and women's choices regarding family size.

stories.title: Best Buy sued after $600 open-box TV labelled 'Excellent' arrived broken
Teacher fired for refusing Covid tests wins as court says school board cannot skip dismissal hearing
stories.summary: Neal Follman, a dedicated teacher from Philadelphia, faced termination after he declined to participate in mandatory Covid-19 testing set by the school district. He challenged this dismissal, claiming that the hearing was improperly conducted. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in his favor, underscoring that no elected board members were present during his hearing.

stories.title: 3 leopards found dead in North Kashmir, poisoning suspected
The Euclid space telescope has spotted 31 ancient quasars, including two record-breakers
stories.summary: The Euclid space telescope has made a groundbreaking discovery by identifying 31 ancient quasars, significantly contributing to the field of astronomy. Notably, two of these quasars hold the record for their vast distances, originating when the Universe was just 670 million years old. Their light journeyed over 13 billion years to reach Earth, offering unparalleled insights into the early stages of cosmic history.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh man detained in Jammu over Pakistan link
Will reverse Greg Abbott's H-1B hiring freeze: Texas governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says schools need foreign teachers
Mick Jagger's former Australian filming retreat hits the market after major restoration work
stories.summary: Palerang Homestead, a stunning property in New South Wales, is up for sale after nearly three decades under family stewardship. This estate is not only historically rich, with ties to Mick Jagger during the filming of Ned Kelly, but also exemplifies sustainable farming practices that have garnered international praise. With its working farm and agricultural opportunities, this estate promises to attract diverse potential buyers, merging history with farming viability.

stories.title: Ship attacks in Persian Gulf: Shipping minister Sonowal asks maritime regulator to be on high alert in high-risk areas

I started my career from minus Rs 1 crore: IIT-Delhi graduate recounts how family debt pushed him to strive but he never gave up on his dream. Left Google to start his own app that now has Silicon Valley's backing
Washington husband charged after rubbing his hands, covered with burrito residue, on wife's face during argument; wife immediately collapsed due to gluten allergy
Illinois woman was murdered in 1966; family friend who carried her coffin convicted 60 years later
stories.summary: In a harrowing case that spanned nearly six decades, eighteen-year-old Karen Snider lost her life in her home, leaving her infant daughter nearby. A breakthrough in DNA evidence recently led to the conviction of family friend James Barbier for her murder. The long-awaited justice has brought a sigh of relief to Karen's daughter, who now has answers about her mother's untimely death.

stories.title: Satellite images 38 years apart show Indonesia's Puncak Jaya glaciers shrinking to tiny ice patches
stories.summary: Puncak Jaya has lost nearly all its glacier ice due to rising temperatures and changing weather patterns. Recent satellite images reveal a stark reduction in glacier coverage over the past decades. The melting glaciers impact local climates and contribute to global challenges despite their small size. Research indicates that the remaining ice also holds important climate history, which will soon be lost.

stories.title: Shawarma fight in Canada turns into racist attack: Montreal restaurant worker beaten up after customer complains about meat portion, jumps over the counter, asks restaurant manager to return to his country
Indian national Anuj Kumar accused of molesting 14-year-old boy while driving Uber in California was in US illegally, DHS says he was released from jail despite ICE detainer
Shenzhen Trilateral: India cautious amid possible vindication and strategic concerns
Indian-origin Manpreet Singh wanted in Canada over fatal Brampton shooting
'India has become a side player': Rahul attacks PM Modi's foreign policy, cites Pak's role in Iran-US talks
Foreign medical graduates to get Rs 30,000 monthly stipend at five central hospitals
stories.summary: In a significant move, the Centre has approved a stipend of Rs 30,070 for foreign medical graduates interning in India, effective November 16. This decision ensures equal pay for both foreign and Indian medical interns, adhering to the National Medical Commission's guidelines issued earlier this year. Several government medical institutions are set to adopt this stipend without delay, marking an important step in supporting foreign medical professionals.

stories.title: Washington landowner's dam repairs led to neighbour's pond filling with sediment; what the court said
stories.summary: In a pivotal decision, a Washington state court upheld a significant $554,000 judgment against Robert Shawn Noecker due to extensive property damages linked to unauthorized construction on a malfunctioning dam. This mishap not only unleashed water and debris but was further exacerbated by drainage modifications that redirected water onto his land.

stories.title: Pennsylvania finds Walmart child labour violations; retailer agrees to pay $7.8m after injuries
stories.summary: Walmart has reached a settlement in response to a Pennsylvania investigation that uncovered serious breaches of child labour laws. The probe identified instances of young workers facing excessive hours and lacking work permits across various locations. As part of the settlement, Walmart will incur penalties of $7.8 million and must adopt stricter compliance protocols to safeguard young employees, setting a crucial benchmark in tackling child labour issues in the state.

stories.title: Scientists found 37 carpet pythons in Cape York and recorded one growing 33.5 cm in 848 days

Unpaid Settlement Lawsuit: Newmans sue association and 33 residents; $200,000 settlement shares remain unpaid
stories.summary: In De Pere, Wisconsin, a family faces a contentious dispute with their homeowners association regarding a fence. After winning a $200,000 settlement for being denied permission to build a fence for their children, tensions have escalated. The association has spread the financial burden among property owners, many of whom have failed to contribute.

stories.title: In 2023, teams began removing invasive spotted bass from South Africa's Breekkrans River
stories.summary: A dedicated conservation initiative along the Breekkrans River is tackling the dangers of invasive spotted bass. The project aims to safeguard the critically endangered doring fiery redfin, which is currently struggling for survival. By eradicating these invasive fish, the redfin’s habitat will expand, giving it a better chance of thriving. Innovative removal methods are employed while also creating job opportunities for the local community, thereby bolstering freshwater conservation efforts.

stories.title: Zeynab Javadli, ex-wife of Dubai prince Sheikh Saeed, alleges UAE officials drugged her, took daughters
stories.summary: Zeynab Javadli, former wife of Dubai prince Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum, has approached the United Nations seeking an investigation into allegations that UAE officials assaulted and drugged her during a raid in which her three daughters were taken away. Her legal team has also raised concerns over her alleged torture in custody and the children's whereabouts.

The Elms Experience: Newport opens 20-room multisensory tour; scents and projections evoke Gilded Age
stories.summary: The Elms mansion in Newport, Rhode Island, has introduced a multisensory experience designed to captivate guests. This innovative attraction includes interactive installations that combine scents, sounds, and historical narratives. After three years of development with Digital Kitchen, the mansion’s historical essence is preserved while incorporating QR codes to provide deeper insights. The Preservation Society aims to enrich visitor experiences and modernize storytelling in historic homes, ensuring educational significance remains intact.

'Bring them back': To end terror, Amit Shah pushes to hunt down fugitives hiding abroad
stories.summary: Amit Shah emphasized the need for international cooperation in the fight against terrorism and organized crime, specifically calling for the return of offenders hiding abroad. He pointed out important milestones, such as the dismantling of the Popular Front of India network. The ongoing two-day Anti-Terror Conference aims to foster intelligence sharing and strengthen investigations, ultimately enhancing inter-agency collaboration to tackle evolving security threats.

stories.title: Bloomberg reporter barred from Trump-Xi-Putin meeting after question on former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
Mahadev betting app case: Kingpin Saurabh Chandrakar sent to judicial custody till December 2
stories.summary: Saurabh Chandrakar has been sent to judicial custody until December 2 by a special court in Raipur. The Enforcement Directorate indicated that it does not require further custodial interrogation at this point. Chandrakar was extradited from Oman earlier this month and produced before the court after a CBI operation. Allegations suggest he operated an illegal online betting network earning significant amounts monthly since 2020.

James Packer sells Aspen mansion for $42.7 million
stories.summary: Australian billionaire James Packer has successfully offloaded his opulent Aspen mansion for $42.7 million, a staggering return on his 2013 investment of $15.6 million. The breathtaking Tuscan-inspired estate has been acquired by tech entrepreneur Alex Davis and his wife, Lindsay, who are no strangers to the Aspen community. With Packer having moved on from the U.S.

‘I am now 80’: Siddaramaiah rules out contesting next Karnataka Assembly elections
'Bhookh itni hai, pet bharta hi nhi': PM Modi pulls up industrialists over lack of jobs, low pay despite tax cuts
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Thursday urged industry leaders to prioritise employee compensation and expand their workforce. He cited governmental efforts to bolster the business climate, such as lowering corporate taxes and simplifying tax regulations. PM Modi also emphasised the importance of maintaining high product standards, and reducing reliance on imported pharmaceuticals to fortify local industries.

stories.title: Canadian condo owner loses case over neighbours’ scented laundry after claiming smell kept her off balcony since 2018
stories.summary: In British Columbia, a woman's legal complaint against her neighbors' scented laundry products was dismissed after the strata council's investigation failed to pinpoint the odor's source. The tribunal ruled that the fragrances did not amount to a nuisance, underlining the difficulties residents face when addressing such grievances in condo living situations, where personal spaces can sometimes clash.

stories.summary: Recent global dialogues have seen the leaders of the United States, China, and Russia unify on pressing issues like reforms at the UN and collaborative energy efforts. The International Court of Justice has made a pivotal ruling on Myanmar's military conduct against Rohingya Muslims, highlighting it in a profound genocide case.

stories.title: Next door, worlds apart: India's child malnutrition puzzle
stories.summary: Child malnutrition is shaped by several factors, including maternal education and household wealth. While India's stunting rate has declined nationally, problems such as child wasting persist. A closer look at the latest survey data reveals striking differences even between neighbouring districts and raises questions about what lies behind these gaps.

stories.title: 'Hyderabadi biryani not preferred': Azam Khan takes veiled dig at Owaisi ahead of UP polls
UK refinery worker uses ChatGPT to fight £100 parking fine for three years, wins case before court
stories.summary: Rafal Goral, a dedicated refinery worker from Chelmsford, has emerged victorious against a parking fine that plagued him for three years. The fine stemmed from a brief 16-minute delay in payment at a Newquay car park. With the invaluable help of ChatGPT, Goral crafted compelling arguments for his case, ultimately leading the parking company to drop the charges just before a court hearing.

stories.title: ‘TN becoming Vice City’: Stalin targets Vijay over Rs 140-crore heroin haul in Chennai
India, Italy target €20bn trade by 2029, explore economic corridor linking Asia and Europe
stories.summary: India and Italy aim to elevate their bilateral trade to €20 billion by 2029, establishing dedicated task forces in both nations to help local businesses tackle bureaucratic hurdles more effectively. Furthermore, they explored the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor, recognizing Italy's strategic ports like Trieste as crucial to boost trade connectivity. An exciting proposal also emerged for an Innovation Hub in India to strengthen technological collaborations.

stories.title: As Sonia Gandhi’s memoir draws attention, Sikh family preserves her ancestral home in Italian village
stories.summary: Sukhdev Singh Kang has purchased the ancestral home of Sonia Gandhi located in Italy and intends to open a museum. The property, identified as Sonia Gandhi's birthplace, has garnered significant interest from Indian visitors. Kang's family aims to preserve her family's history through artifacts and personal items displayed at the museum. They also plan to meet with Sonia Gandhi and her children to enrich the museum experience.

82-year-old Arkansas man loses appeal over sale of family's 331 acres after 30 years living there
stories.summary: William J Cooper, an 82-year-old resident, faced significant hurdles in selling his family's inherited land as ordered by the court. Although he sought a physical division to continue living there, the Arkansas Court of Appeals ultimately deemed his appeal moot after the property was sold to a third party. This case highlights the complex challenges heirs may encounter in property disputes.

stories.title: Isolated tribe Awá emereges from Brazilian Amazon forest amid alarming threats by illegal invaders
stories.summary: Recently, the elusive Awá tribe, famed for their isolation, reached out to a neighboring settlement in the Arariboia Indigenous territory. In search of food and assistance, their visit exposed the severe impacts of illegal land encroachments. Local villagers documented the meeting, bringing attention to the perils that Indigenous people face. Advocacy groups are demanding stronger safeguards and acknowledgment of the rights of uncontacted tribes to preserve their way of life.

stories.title: PUC rules changed: BS-I to BS-VI vehicles get new certificate validity periods; check yours
stories.summary: The ministry of road transport and highways recently unveiled revised regulations concerning pollution under control certificates. The new guidelines offer longer validity for BS-VI vehicles based on their age and usage while mandating more frequent emission checks for older vehicles. Furthermore, there will be a standardised validity period for older emission categories throughout India, enhancing compliance and promoting uniformity in emission standards.

PM Modi pays tribute to former PM Indira Gandhi on birth anniversary
stories.summary: On the occasion of Indira Gandhi's birth anniversary, Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Karnataka chief minister D K Shivakumar paid tribute to her legacy. PM Modi shared a heartfelt message on X, recognizing her immense contributions to India's progress. Shivakumar referred to her as the 'Iron Lady,' praising her pivotal roles in sectors such as agriculture and banking, and underscoring her enduring influence on the country’s political landscape.

stories.title: 'Use of natural resources boomerang-ing back to bite': India accuses Pakistan of self-aggrandisement
stories.summary: India flagged Pakistan's military establishment of exploiting the country's natural resources for personal gain and fomenting conflict with neighbours at a UNSC meeting. India's UN envoy Parvathaneni Harish also hit back at Islamabad for raising the Indus Waters Treaty, citing army chief Asim Munir's display of minerals to foreign leaders and calling on Pakistan's military to prioritise public welfare over self-aggrandisement.

Derbyshire man buries £4,000 Boeing 737 to build underground party bunker
Music Centre Opens To Public: Monmouth unveils Springsteen archive; spans American music history
stories.summary: Scheduled to launch on June 13, 2026, the Bruce Springsteen Center for American Music at Monmouth University aspires to uphold America's musical legacy and accentuate the cultural impact of music in the nation. The center will showcase a remarkable collection of over 48,000 artifacts, including items from Springsteen and other legends.

stories.title: Kandinsky painting sells for record $85.8 million, nearly doubling artist's previous auction high
stories.summary: Wassily Kandinsky’s painting Betonte Ecken achieved a record-breaking price of $85.8 million at Christie’s New York. The auction event generated a total of $627 million and included numerous notable artworks. Competitive bidding was evident, with multiple collectors participating for high-value pieces. Other artists like Gustav Klimt and Pablo Picasso also saw substantial sales. The results indicate a vibrant market for modern and Impressionist art continues to thrive.

stories.title: ‘50cr Indians defeated poverty’: PM Modi counters Rahul’s ‘economic disaster’ remark, cites World Bank figures
Malaysia to not remain visa free for Indian visitors from Jan 1, 2027
stories.summary: Malaysia will end the visa exemption policy for Indian tourists beginning on January 1, 2027. This decision comes after an increase in Indians misusing the visa-free entry for employment purposes. The High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur has issued warnings regarding these violations of immigration rules. Indian nationals must obtain a valid visa prior to travelling to Malaysia from this date onward.

stories.title: British Airways passenger wins £12 interest case after £2,000 hotel bill
A US partnership turned 2.5 million pounds of unsold food and drinks into renewable energy
'Not inclined to interfere': Supreme Court rejects ED plea against Azam Khan's interim bail
Pakistan minister who warned India over Indus Waters Treaty to attend SCO meet in Delhi
Elton John's public railway station piano heads to auction for AIDS charity, estimated at £250,000
stories.summary: Elton John's iconic Yamaha piano, which has graced St Pancras International since 2016, is set to be auctioned soon to support the Elton John AIDS Foundation in honor of World AIDS Day. This rare item not only represents a significant moment in British music history but also offers bidders a chance to contribute to a vital cause.

stories.title: Oceanwide Plaza Revival: 250 Balconies Cleared; $850 million plan awaits financing
stories.summary: In downtown Los Angeles, the partially completed Oceanwide Plaza is getting a makeover as graffiti is being removed. With $850 million pledged by KPC Group and Lendlease, this project is set to offer luxury residences, a hotel, and retail spaces. Positioned as a key component of the city's strategy to uplift the downtown area for the 2028 Summer Olympics, community engagement will be central to these revitalization efforts.

stories.title: Tasmania Wilderness Rescue: Beacon Helps Locate Two Hikers; police urge hikers to carry safety gear
stories.summary: In Tasmania, two bushwalkers found themselves in a perilous situation due to unexpected weather changes, prompting them to activate their personal locator beacon for assistance. While emergency services launched a rescue mission, harsh conditions hindered helicopter access, leading a search-and-rescue team to trek through difficult landscapes to reach the hikers.

stories.title: NASA maps show 2026 El Niño resembles 1997; NOAA sees 83% chance of strong conditions in 2027
stories.summary: Recent satellite observations reveal striking similarities between the anticipated 2026 El Niño and the notorious 1997 event. Elevated sea levels across the Pacific are raising alarm among scientists regarding its expected severity. This climatic shift could drastically alter global weather patterns, with countries like India potentially facing erratic monsoon conditions. Experts estimate an 83% likelihood of heightened intensity in early 2027, posing significant risks for various regions.

'India playing a whole new game': PM Modi GTA 6 post showcases country's transformation in 13 years

Madras HC stay puts NEET-PG Round 2 result on hold, candidates await clarity
stories.summary: The delay in the NEET-PG 2026 Round 2 results leaves thousands of medical graduates in limbo. As the Medical Counselling Committee awaits direction from the Madras High Court, the postgraduate medical academic calendar, set to commence on November 20, hangs in the balance. Notably, admissions at Sri Venkateshwaraa Medical College are currently on hold per the court’s interim order.

stories.title: Alex Trebek's former 578-acre California winery ranch heads to December auction
stories.summary: Creston Manor, a majestic estate formerly belonging to Alex Trebek, is now up for auction following an unsuccessful private sale. Spanning an impressive 577 acres, this property boasts vineyards and various residences alongside agricultural ventures. Initially listed at $7 million, the price has been lowered, with online bidding commencing on December 4, leading to a live auction later that month.

stories.title: A great horned owl in Pennsylvania survived being struck by a tractor-trailer travelling at 65 mph
stories.summary: In an incredible tale of survival, a great horned owl in Pennsylvania endured a harrowing journey after being struck by a truck and wedged in its air dam. Traveling roughly 70 miles, the owl was finally found by trucking terminal employees. Despite sustaining an eye injury, it was otherwise unharmed.

stories.title: Metal detectorist Daniel Crowe found a Viking hoard on the Isle of Man
stories.summary: Daniel Crowe made an astonishing discovery of a Viking hoard on the Isle of Man, revealing a trove of jewellery and weapons that shed light on the social hierarchy and burial customs of the early Viking Age. This remarkable collection offers crucial insights into the roles women played in Viking society, with artefacts showcasing intricate designs and suggesting links to extensive trading networks across the British Isles.

stories.title: Researchers discovered a new scorpion species in Odisha's Similipal Tiger Reserve
stories.summary: A newly documented scorpion species has been unveiled, representing the first instance of Liocheles in Odisha. Researchers designated this species as Liocheles similipalensis following an in-depth analysis of its physical traits. With this addition, the total number of recognized Liocheles species globally rises to seven, and four of these have been discovered in India.

stories.title: Hong Kong Case Dropped: Prosecutors cite unreachable witnesses; captain faces deportation
stories.summary: The Hong Kong authorities have chosen to drop the prosecution against Captain Wan Wenguo for the Balticconnector gas pipeline damage, citing challenges in reaching essential witnesses from mainland China. Although he pleaded not guilty, Captain Wan accepted responsibility for safety violations. Evidence connected his vessel to the pipeline incident, leading to expectations of his deportation to mainland China.

stories.title: Major KFC franchisee files for bankruptcy protection, may shut more outlets
stories.summary: A major KFC franchisee, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection citing financial difficulties. The company seeks to restructure its operations and avoid losing its franchise agreement with Yum Brands. Tasty Chick’n has closed 44 restaurant locations this year and may shut down more in the future. The franchisee owes approximately $16 million in unpaid royalties to its parent company, Yum Brands.

stories.title: ‘Revolution, not election’: SP's Azam Khan, on interim bail, predicts 'deluge' in upcoming UP polls
stories.summary: Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan, after receiving interim bail, declared the upcoming Uttar Pradesh Assembly polls a revolution. He criticized constitutional bodies for diminishing public faith and referenced historical educationists to highlight injustice. Khan emphasized that voters will focus on real issues rather than religion and caste in the elections. He expressed readiness to fight for constitutional rights and justice once SP forms a government.

stories.title: Construction Halt: Judge extends arch pause 14 days; court weighs longer ban
stories.summary: US District Judge Tanya Chutkan has granted an extension on the temporary halt of the memorial arch's construction, prolonging it for an additional 14 days. The project faces stiff opposition from various groups and individuals, all having filed multiple lawsuits. It follows prior approval granted to the Trump administration by the National Capital Planning Commission, as the court continues to evaluate further legal arguments and possible injunctions.

stories.title: GTA 6 has an India connection, partly built by developers in Bengaluru: BJP's Tejasvi Surya
stories.summary: Tejasvi Surya from the Bharatiya Janata Party emphasized Bengaluru's role in developing the highly anticipated video game Grand Theft Auto VI. Over 1,600 developers at Rockstar India's Bengaluru studio worked on the game, showcasing the city's gaming ecosystem. The game marks a return to Vice City, featuring two protagonists in an open-world narrative. It has received multiple nominations at the upcoming 2026 Game Awards scheduled for December 10.

stories.title: Health of states: Bihar per capita spend lowest, Sikkim's highest
Ladakh Hill Development Council polls: BJP set to win 1st seat unopposed

stories.summary: During his address at the University of Chicago, Rahul Gandhi emphasized the opposition's strong dedication to engaging in elections and dismissed the idea of a boycott, asserting it would significantly harm India's democratic integrity. He elaborated on troubling aspects of Indian democracy, pointed out escalating issues within the Election Commission, and highlighted serious economic challenges, like high unemployment and education deficits. His visit to the U.S. spans two days.

stories.title: 'The sky will not fall': SC denies to stay Azam bail
stories.summary: Azam Khan was released from Dasna jail after the Allahabad high court granted him interim bail. The Enforcement Directorate failed to provide written grounds for his arrest, which led to the court's decision.

stories.title: Court reopens British mother's fight against daughter's adoption after her life turnaround
stories.summary: A British mother has begun to reclaim her life, overcoming a challenging past marked by substance abuse and domestic violence. Through psychotherapy, she has found stable housing and has maintained her sobriety. The Court of Appeal has given her a chance to contest the adoption of her daughter, previously denied by the Family Court, which deemed her progress still too recent.

stories.title: Florida has secured roughly $5.2 million to protect nearly 830 acres across three farms
stories.summary: In a significant stride for land conservation, Florida's Commissioner of Agriculture, Wilton Simpson, revealed plans to safeguard three distinct properties spanning DeSoto, St. Johns, and Polk counties. These initiatives focus on sustaining agricultural lands while protecting valuable natural resources. Covering nearly 830 acres with diverse landscapes, including wetlands and forests, these easements are valued at over $5 million, allowing farmers to maintain their operations without land development.

stories.summary: In a tragic turn of events, three children are pursuing a wrongful death lawsuit following the passing of their parents, John and Kristen Ruskey, due to carbon monoxide poisoning on February 8, 2026, at their seaside home. The lawsuit claims that a faulty water heater and a malfunctioning carbon monoxide detector were significant factors in their untimely deaths.

stories.title: Two brain regions tied to memory and emotion may shrink up a decade before Alzheimer’s symptoms
stories.summary: A groundbreaking study from Johns Hopkins University highlights early brain changes associated with Alzheimer's disease. Specifically, it finds that tissue loss in the entorhinal cortex and amygdala occurs years before hippocampal changes manifest. The research suggests that abnormal tau protein accumulation may play a crucial role in this deterioration. Identifying these early changes could pave the way for timely interventions, enhancing future strategies for Alzheimer's prevention and treatment.

stories.title: Court denies biological father parenthood rights after sexual assault finding
stories.summary: A Washington court ruled against a man's request for legal fatherhood of a child conceived through sexual assault. The ruling was based on Washington's Uniform Parentage Act, which addresses situations involving sexual violence. The child's mother provided credible evidence of ongoing abuse and intimidation from the man throughout their relationship. While the man claimed the relationship was consensual, the court found his testimony inconsistent and unconvincing.

stories.title: 1960 New Jersey home with wave-shaped roof lists for $1.65 million, studio for $995,000
stories.summary: Jules Gregory's Wave House in Lambertville has transitioned to condo status, now offering buyers the exciting option to purchase the main house, the separate studio, or both. The main residence boasts a distinctive architectural style with a generous open floor layout, while the studio presents a perfect solution for those desiring a cozy, minimalist living environment. This development allows prospective purchasers greater flexibility in selecting their ideal living arrangement.

stories.title: American couple turned a Volkswagen side hustle into a $30M hammock business
stories.summary: In 2011, Joe Demin and Rachel Connors embarked on a journey with Yellow Leaf Hammocks, originally as a side venture. Specializing in handwoven hammocks crafted by the Mlabri Tribe in Thailand, the couple faced a turning point during the pandemic. Post-Shark Tank, they pivoted to a direct-to-consumer model, empowering local women through training and crafting. Their dedication culminated in over $30 million in sales, profoundly impacting families.

stories.title: CJI averts 'potential religious row', pulls cases from SC judge
stories.summary: CJI Surya Kant withdrew two cases from the bench headed by Justice Ahsanuddin Amanullah, averting a potential religious controversy.

stories.title: Can an Italian raise slogans against govt while in India on visa? SC to hear PIL
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has agreed to consider a petition concerning Italian Giacomo Filibeck's comments during a recent conference in Hyderabad. The petition claims that he breached visa terms by supporting local political matters.

stories.title: US court to Delhi courts: Help serve summons to RAW ex-chief, Doval
stories.summary: The order was issued in a civil lawsuit filed by Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, founder of pro-Khalistan outfit Sikhs for Justice (SFJ).

stories.title: GTA 6 Release: Nearly 1 in 5 US workers plan time off; 36% consider calling in sick
stories.summary: GTA 6's November 19 release has prompted workers across the United States to plan time off, with some even considering calling in sick. While Lander Allgood and Connor Folkers have arranged extended breaks to enjoy the game, others are choosing to wait until Thanksgiving. The launch has become a major event for gaming enthusiasts.

stories.title: 35 yrs on, a landmark moment: Forces kill Kashmir's last active local terrorist
stories.summary: Security forces gunned down Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Mohammad Lateef Bhat during a shootout outside a mosque in Kulgam. This incident concluded a weeklong operation to find him after the attack on a CRPF picket in Kulgam on November 11.

stories.title: Appeals Ruling: Court upholds $5,000 award; deck stays, unauthorised builds still carry costs
stories.summary: Moira and Denis Holden, a couple from Canada, constructed an unapproved wooden deck next to their cabin. They contested a demand from Valley's Edge Park Ltd. to have it taken down. The British Columbia Court of Appeal decided to uphold a $5,000 damages judgment, rather than requiring the deck's removal, as it found no notable adverse effects on the neighboring properties.

stories.title: Periodic radio bursts point to complex magnetic structure; source identity remains unresolved
stories.summary: Astronomers have made a remarkable discovery with a newly identified cosmic object, LPT J1555−5631, known for emitting intriguing radio pulses. This celestial entity produced bursts of radio waves over a span of 15 hours, then went silent for five years. Scientists are delving into its classification potential, considering various options like pulsars and magnetars, while the challenge lies in understanding its unique emission mechanisms and patterns.

stories.title: Portland architect's flower-shaped forest home lists for $2.888 million
stories.summary: A unique forest home in Portland designed by architect Robert Oshatz is now listed at $2.888 million. The property features curved ceilings and disappearing glass walls that blend living space with nature. It includes four bedrooms, four bathrooms, and multiple levels accessible by an elevator. The home is part of a larger planned collection of residences sharing forested land.

stories.title: Woman wins nearly $2.8 million after suffering burns from hot barbecue sauce
Keralam ministers question CM's key calls at cabinet meet
stories.summary: Keralam CM V D Satheesan encountered questions regarding key decisions during the cabinet meeting on Wednesday. Ministers raised concerns about appointments and representation, leading to discussions for nearly two-and-a-half hours.

stories.title: Govt hospitals to hike Ayushman packages from 23 to 112
stories.summary: Patients under Ayushman Bharat will soon have access to a broader range of medical treatments and surgical procedures. The government plans to expand packages from 23 to 112, covering various health conditions and treatments. New packages will include procedures like hysterectomy, circumcision, and diabetic-related complications. Community health centres and sub-divisional hospitals will provide these services, depending on available infrastructure and staff.

stories.title: SC starts contempt case against lawyer for remarks against CJI
stories.summary: A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta, Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed the lawyer to file his response by January 8 and also ordered him to appear personally before it on the next date of hearing on January 20.

stories.title: Connecticut court upholds $62,530 award in employee's disability discrimination case
stories.summary: After colleagues reported a marijuana scent near her car, Latoya Council was fired from Charter Communications. Despite no evidence of her smoking or possessing marijuana at work, the ruling upheld by the Appellate Court pointed to bias against her PTSD condition. Following a protracted legal struggle, she secured compensation for her unjust termination, emphasizing the ongoing conflict between workplace regulations and the rights of those with disabilities.

stories.title: Psychology says a few minutes of your speech may reveal how fast your brain is aging
stories.summary: A groundbreaking speech clock has been developed by researchers to evaluate speech patterns and estimate biological age. This innovative tool highlights the potential relationship between speech traits and cognitive decline, including dementia. Involving nearly 3,000 Spanish-speaking participants from various Latin American nations, the results suggest that noticeable differences in speech age may signal cognitive difficulties. Future research is essential to further explore the role of speech analysis in cognitive evaluations.

stories.title: Jeff Bridges leads US child-hunger campaign targeting 10 million children by 2032
stories.summary: Jeff Bridges is spearheading the Amplify Impact campaign aimed at eradicating child hunger across America. This ambitious initiative seeks to support 10 million children by 2032, highlighting innovative local solutions to the hunger crisis. Backed by a substantial $5 million in grants from No Kid Hungry, the campaign will fortify nutrition programs to ensure that every child has access to wholesome meals.

stories.title: US man accused of plotting foiled Hindu temple shooting in Illinois faces new charges
stories.summary: Alexandros Paporakis, a 19-year-old resident of Palatine, faces severe charges including terrorism and armed violence after allegedly planning a mass shooting targeting a Hindu temple during the Navaratri festival. Reports from his co-workers contributed to his arrest, during which law enforcement discovered weapons and extremist propaganda. This incident has raised alarms within the Hindu community about escalating hate crimes.

stories.title: Palm Beach mansion linked to $194m CIA fraud sells for $24m after government seizure
stories.summary: In a stunning development, a lavish mansion in Palm Beach, Florida, has changed hands for $24 million. This opulent property was acquired using funds siphoned from a substantial government fraud scheme, orchestrated by the previous owner, David T. Nichols, who confessed to embezzling nearly $194 million. Following his conviction, authorities seized the estate, and the proceeds from this sale will aid in recovering the losses stemming from this extensive fraud.

stories.title: Canadian judge rejects son's inheritance claim but orders family firms to disclose financial records
stories.summary: In a recent legal dispute, a son faced a setback in his claims over family companies and property ownership. He believed his shareholder status gave him rights to specific assets within those firms. However, the court clarified that his view of shareholder entitlements was flawed, emphasizing that his rights pertained only to his investment. While his oppression claim was dismissed, he was permitted access to the company's financial documentation.

stories.title: Texas homeowners secure $1.9 million settlement and protections over nearby data centre project
stories.summary: Homeowners in Westlake, Texas, have come to an agreement concerning a proposed data centre that had sparked concerns. The settlement includes a financial contribution from developer PowerHouse earmarked for noise reduction and fire safety measures. Furthermore, the project will adhere to specific operational limits and environmental safeguards to alleviate resident anxieties. Though this venture promises to enhance Westlake's revenue significantly, community opinions remain split regarding the development.

stories.title: Pennsylvania landowner's 4540 acre forest protected from subdivision, preserving public recreation access
stories.summary: The Western Pennsylvania Conservancy has notably secured a vital conservation easement for a sprawling 4,540-acre forest in Pennsylvania. This landmark agreement ensures the land is preserved from any future development, safeguarding its natural elements. Since its establishment in 1932, the organization has protected over 300,000 acres, emphasizing critical wildlife habitats and advocating for sustainable forestry. This initiative highlights the critical role of conservation efforts in the region's ecological future.

stories.title: Cat Reunited With Family: Rescuers find Isaac alive; he hid in a kitchen cabinet
stories.summary: In a heartwarming turn of events, 13-year-old Zariah Coleman was joyously reunited with her beloved cat, Isaac, four days after a devastating building collapse that claimed eight lives. Amid the wreckage, rescue teams from various organizations banded together, ultimately finding Isaac snugly tucked away in a kitchen cabinet. Despite the chaos, the reunion brought a precious moment of happiness for Zariah and her mother.

stories.title: India to add 75,000 medical seats by 2029, says health minister J P Nadda
Historic first: Democrat Hakeem Jeffries nominated to become House Speaker
Private bikes, delivery services can generate 18 cr jobs: Gadkari
In 1997, Princess Diana stayed at Cape Town’s Tarrystone Estate, now listed for R150 million
stories.summary: Tarrystone Estate in Cape Town, once the South African home of Princess Diana’s younger brother, Charles Spencer, is now on the market for R150 million. Diana stayed at the property during her March 1997 visit to South Africa, just months before her death. The cottage where she stayed has been preserved on the sprawling estate.

stories.title: Punjab assembly polls: Congress likely to release first list of candidates in 10-15 days
Court lets New Hampshire homeowners pursue group trespass claim over chemical water pollution
stories.summary: A federal appeals court has permitted New Hampshire homeowners to advance a class-action trespass claim against Saint-Gobain. However, the court denied group treatment for negligence and failure-to-warn claims due to individual property assessments. Contamination of drinking water due to PFOA emissions from a manufacturing plant has been identified. The ruling acknowledged the homeowners' right to seek compensation while leaving individual claims to be determined later.

stories.title: Amit Shah to inaugurate NIA anti-terror conference on cross-border terrorism
'Suffering because of that': Moily says certain Congress leaders stalled probe against Modi during UPA regime
'Balasaheb like a deity to us': Eknath Shinde defends Shaina NC in photo row, says she has clarified
Virginia court settles family dispute over Smith Mountain Lake home and inherited ownership shares
stories.summary: A legal conflict concerning a Virginia lakeside property has escalated to the state's Court of Appeals. The court determined that Joan Cabaniss holds a 50% ownership share, while her late husband's children retain the remaining half through his will. Disputes over inheritance and property rights, including a contested quitclaim deed from one child, have been addressed.

stories.title: Rare 1911 Denver Mint gold coin found in family safe-deposit box could fetch $500,000+
stories.summary: A remarkable discovery has surfaced—a $10 gold coin from 1911 that was hidden away in a family safe deposit box. Graded PCGS MS 65 and sanctioned by Certified Acceptance Corporation, this rare find is projected to sell for over $500,000 at an auction in January 2027. With only about 1,650 known examples in existence, such rare items often remain undetected until expert grading brings them into the spotlight.

stories.title: 'Addiction to being in spotlight': BJP says Rahul 'defames' India to grab headlines amid row over his remarks in US
Missouri couple win $47,500 after former sellers block property sale over a paid-off mortgage
stories.summary: In a challenging situation, a couple in Missouri struggled to sell their home when previous sellers refused to acknowledge a cleared mortgage. This conflict prompted a court's decision to award them $47,500 in damages after evidence confirmed the mortgage was paid off. The ruling also covered legal fees, underscoring the critical need for transparent financial protocols in real estate dealings.

stories.title: UNICEF and IAP launch ‘Child Rights Pledge Platform’ to make pediatricians voice for wellbeing of children
Tom Holland and Zendaya buy £8.25 million London mansion at £750,000 discount
stories.summary: Tom Holland and Zendaya have reportedly purchased an £8.25 million mansion in London, paying £750,000 below its asking price. The five-bedroom property spans over 5,000 square feet and sits on an acre of land. The reported cash purchase adds another impressive real estate investment to the couple’s growing property portfolio.

stories.title: 'Look forward to strengthen India-UK ties': PM Modi shares pictures after meeting Prince William, Kate Middleton
US will not have a Christian majority by 2027: Pew study
Arizona parents commit $7.1 million to research after son's rare eye disease diagnosis
Lady Gaga’s former NYC penthouse, also home to Carmelo Anthony, Tracy Morgan, listed for $7 million
stories.summary: Lady Gaga’s former New York City penthouse has hit the market for $6.995 million. The 3,700-square-foot luxury duplex, which was also once home to Carmelo Anthony and Tracy Morgan, features three bedrooms, a chef’s kitchen and a sprawling terrace offering stunning city views. The property is located in the iconic Hit Factory Condominium.

stories.title: Punjab CM Mann seeks MEA permission to visit Kartarpur Sahib in Pakistan
Pearl Harbor survivor Gebhard Galle, who rescued 4 sailors from sinking ship, dies at 105
Hindu population growth to fall behind other religions in India, globally: Pew Study
Bruce Springsteen's $50 million New Jersey archive opens, housing 48,000-plus items
stories.summary: Monmouth University in New Jersey has proudly unveiled the Bruce Springsteen Center for American Music, featuring over 48,000 artifacts that delve into the rich heritage of American music and celebrate the impact of Bruce Springsteen. Its inaugural exhibit highlights the evolution of protest music across history, and interactive setups invite attendees to immerse themselves in the experience.

stories.title: Carrion crows can decide which way a cloud of dots was moving in about 235 milliseconds
stories.summary: In a fascinating study from the University of Tübingen, researchers discovered that carrion crows possess a remarkable ability to determine the direction of moving dots far more swiftly than both humans and monkeys. Their decision-making occurs in a mere 235 milliseconds, with neural activity indicating decision processes before physical actions take place. This research enhances our understanding of the rapid cognitive capabilities present in various animal species.

stories.title: Sergey Brin puts Malibu estate on the market for $33.5M
stories.summary: Sergey Brin and Nicole Shanahan have decided to sell their Malibu home for $33.5 million. After initially listing it as a luxury rental for $175,000, they opted to sell. The home includes five bedrooms and offers direct access to Little Dume Beach. Previously owned by pop singer Pink, the estate features impressive amenities and ocean views. Brin continues to invest in Malibu real estate, owning multiple properties in the area.

stories.title: Gujarat farmers seek next-gen GM crops, call for science-led policy on farm technology
US deports Khalistan supporter linked to Punjab railway blast, held in Delhi
Missouri university employee keeps $631,000 discrimination award; retrial ordered
stories.summary: In a recent ruling, a Missouri court confirmed the jury's conclusion that Lincoln University established a racially hostile work setting for Sheila Gassner. The court did, however, nullify the damages linked to her constructive discharge claim and called for a new trial. Gassner, who endured heavy workloads while overseeing various departments, encountered discrimination after she raised issues.

stories.title: Trump, Putin to hold talks in China after 2025 Alaska summit failed to end Ukraine war
PM Modi chairs council of ministers meet; end of Naxalism, world bank report on poverty discussed
Texas man loses $105,000 property claim after failing to trace inheritance in divorce case
stories.summary: A Texas appellate court has confirmed a lower court's decision regarding the divorce property division between Julian and Alice Devon Poole. Julian claimed certain assets as his separate property, including his inheritance and savings. However, the court found he failed to substantiate his claims adequately, leading to a ruling that mandates an equal division of marital assets between the spouses, thus upholding the trial court's verdict.

stories.title: Before the first bullet: Army rescued 27 from seminary, then hunted LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat
Evening news wrap: Xi hosts Trump ahead of trilateral meeting with Putin; Sena vs Sena row over Bal Thackeray's photo & more
Bangladesh ready to work with India to trace missing Assam woman
'A lot of it is connected': Rahul Gandhi links India, France, US to global economic shifts
'Contacted my assistant': MK Stalin says did not get 'formal' invite for Sonia Gandhi’s book launch
'Five defining features': Jaishankar decodes the changing world order
stories.summary: During his speech in Japan, S Jaishankar highlighted concerns about the weaponization of the global economy, noting key trends that are redefining international relationships such as strategic rivalry and resource manipulation. He stressed the necessity for trustworthy alliances and diversification amid economic uncertainties. Jaishankar further advocated for deepened collaboration between India and Japan across multiple sectors, as this could foster enhanced stability in the Indo-Pacific region.

stories.title: Trump pushes ban on Chinese AI data center gear despite tech giants' pushback
stories.summary: In the midst of escalating tensions, the Trump administration is poised to restrict imports of Chinese optical transceivers essential for AI data centers. Tech giants warn that such a shift could lead to a decade-long replacement process due to existing market constraints. Concurrently, China advocates for the removal of semiconductor technology limitations, stating that these hinder the market potential of its companies.

stories.title: 3 10-year-olds find 1,900-year-old coin while playing with air blower on school trip in Jerusalem Hills
stories.summary: On a school excursion in the Jerusalem Hills, three curious children uncovered a remarkable 1,900-year-old coin while engaged in play. This ancient artifact, believed to originate from the rule of Roman Emperor Hadrian between 117 and 138 CE, caught the attention of experts after the children promptly informed their teacher.

stories.title: 'B team of SP, Congress': CM Yogi targets Owaisi-Chandrashekhar alliance ahead of UP polls
stories.summary: In a recent statement, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath condemned the collaboration between AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi and Chandrashekhar Aazad, labeling it as a secondary faction for the Samajwadi Party and Congress. As both leaders gear up for the upcoming 2027 Assembly elections, they aim to challenge the BJP's grip on power.

stories.title: Dakota apartment owned by Tribeca Film Festival founders sells after price cut
stories.summary: After nearly ten years of trying to sell their apartment at the Dakota, the couple has finally found a buyer. The apartment was initially listed at $39 million but was later reduced to $12.5 million. Located on Central Park, the spacious unit spans about 6,000 square feet, offering stunning views of the park. The sale comes after significant price cuts and complex negotiations between the former couple.

stories.title: NCBS researcher from Bengaluru wins Google PhD Fellowship
'Whitewashing history': Shiv Sena Shinde faction leaders tear up a copy of Sonia Gandhi's memoir
'Lateef killed': Forces celebrate in Kulgam as Kashmir’s last known active local terrorist falls
'Youth must know what UP was like 10 years ago': CM Yogi renews 'batenge toh katenge' pitch
stories.summary: Yogi Adityanath defended his slogans at the News18 Rising Bharat Summit, emphasizing awareness of Uttar Pradesh's historical issues. He highlighted past governance failures, including riots and insecurity, under the Samajwadi Party. Adityanath claimed the state is now safer and riot-free under BJP leadership. He reiterated that security, nationalism, and cultural nationalism would be central themes in upcoming elections.

stories.title: Saffron saree row: West Bengal government to probe claim Kolkata school questioned teacher's dress choice
stories.summary: West Bengal education minister Dipak Barman is set to investigate allegations regarding a teacher's attire at a missionary school. The charges claim a colleague questioned the teacher for wearing saffron sarees, alleging a dress code violation. Chief minister Suvendu Adhikari indicated potential actions against individuals or the institution if complaints are verified. BJP's Samik Bhattacharya also raised concerns about possible religious conversions at such institutions.

stories.title: SC to hear PIL against Italian politician’s ‘Vote Chor’ remarks at Bharat Summit
J&K: Kulgam attack mastermind Lateef Bhat killed after week-long operation
stories.summary: In a significant operation, security forces eliminated Mohammad Lateef Bhat in Kulgam after a series of strategic maneuvers lasting a week. Earlier, his associate, Umar Nisar Dar, was taken down in a separate encounter. Lateef had wounded three CRPF personnel during a recent attack and had evaded capture since then. The authorities reiterated their strong stance against further terrorist activities in the region.

stories.title: Wrongful Death Settlement: Brown family secures $5 million; claims against Walgreens remain pending
stories.summary: The family of Banko Brown, a Black transgender man fatally shot by a security guard, has secured a $5 million settlement related to claims against the guard and his employer. However, the legal battle continues, as the family's lawsuit against Walgreens and Allied Universal Security Services remains unresolved in court.

stories.title: Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr back new Beatles attraction in Liverpool; will support young local artists
stories.summary: Liverpool is set to unveil a major Beatles attraction by 2028, championed by Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr. This expansive 100,000-square-foot venue will replace the Beatles Story at Albert Dock, featuring immersive exhibits designed to boost tourism. A portion of ticket sales will support local artists via the Apple Corps Liverpool Trust, aiming to celebrate young talent and align with the premiere of four Beatles films in April 2028.

stories.title: Michigan woman wins $1 million Powerball prize, plans to pay off her mortgage
stories.summary: Alisa Moore, hailing from Hazel Park, Michigan, recently struck gold by winning a staggering $1 million in the Powerball lottery. She bought her lucky ticket while exiting a Kroger store on October 19. The next day, after thoroughly checking her ticket, she confirmed her fortune. Instead of indulging in luxury, Moore aims to settle her mortgage and wisely invest the leftover amount, showcasing her savvy handling of unexpected wealth.

stories.title: King Charles’ charity wins major battle in £6m handbag designer lawsuit
Guinness Verification Pending: Warren Crawford bowls 243 strikes; fundraiser raises $20,000
stories.summary: Warren Crawford stunned everyone with his astounding bowling prowess, clocking in 243 strikes within a single hour at a charity event that benefitted veterans and first responders. The endeavor successfully garnered around $20,000 in donations. Utilizing a unique two-handed bowling style he honed since childhood, Crawford's incredible achievement now awaits verification from Guinness World Records, all amidst the electrifying support of the audience.

stories.title: Plea alleges Sonia Gandhi used forged papers for 1980 voter entry; court seeks police report
stories.summary: The Rouse Avenue Court has instructed the officer in charge of the IP Estate Police Station to prepare an Action Taken Report regarding a complaint that alleges Sonia Gandhi’s name was on electoral rolls before she was granted Indian citizenship. During proceedings, the advocate presented electoral roll records from 1980 to 1983.

stories.title: Roger Daltrey's cancer charity concerts reach 150 shows, raising over £36 million since 2000
stories.summary: The Teenage Cancer Trust celebrated its 150th concert at London's Royal Albert Hall, raising over £36 million. Founded by Roger Daltrey in 2000, the series features numerous well-known musicians supporting young people with cancer. Performers such as Manic Street Preachers and Elbow participated in the recent program curated by Robert Smith. The charity emphasizes the importance of specialized care for patients aged 13 to 24 during treatment.

stories.title: Teens who met on holiday in 1994 reunite 20 years later and marry
stories.summary: It was in the sun-soaked summer of 1994 when David McArdle encountered Jodie while vacationing in Kos, Greece. Their brief encounter ignited a beautiful friendship carried through pen letters for three years. Life scattered them, but fate intervened after twenty years when Jodie reached out to David's mother. Their profound reconnection blossomed into love, culminating in a proposal atop the London Eye.

stories.title: Journalist turns daughter's fentanyl death into a mission, funding $500,000 in addiction treatment
Hakeem Jeffries faces first test in bid to become first Black US House speaker
stories.summary: As Hakeem Jeffries gears up for a historic election, he prepares to potentially become the first black Speaker of the House, vying for the nomination from House Democrats. Acknowledging calls for change in leadership, Jeffries is proactively connecting with diverse caucuses to build support. His potential victory aligns with other momentous leadership changes, reflecting the priorities of newly elected lawmakers eager to push legislative agendas before their official induction.

stories.title: SCBA urges Supreme Court to initiate criminal contempt proceedings against advocate
Island Nations Seek Climate Funding: States press for emissions cuts; seek $700 million for resilience
stories.summary: Small island nations are urgently calling for action at climate negotiations due to the exacerbating threats of global warming. Their leaders stress the essential need for financial aid from wealthier nations, which contribute most to pollution. This call for unity among these nations is becoming increasingly crucial. Young representatives advocate for climate justice and demand accountability from world leaders, as COP31 seeks to reinforce commitments to effectively tackle climate change.

stories.title: 'Heavens will not fall': SC on ED plea challenging Azam Khan's interim bail
Unvaccinated yellow fever-risk travellers may face six-day quarantine; new airport rules propose changes
stories.summary: India has unveiled draft regulations enhancing quarantine protocols for travelers from yellow fever-affected nations. Unvaccinated arrivals could face quarantine of up to six days at their own expense. Airlines will be responsible for transporting non-compliant passengers to designated facilities. Furthermore, new reporting standards concerning passenger health and travel information will be established for airlines. The health ministry is collecting feedback from all stakeholders on these proposed measures before finalization.

stories.title: Tennessee studio estate where Taylor Swift and Dolly Parton recorded lists for $19.5 million
stories.summary: Dark Horse Estate in Franklin, Tennessee is now on the market for $19.5 million. This unique property features recording facilities and accommodations for artists and guests alike. It has a rich history with over 65 gold and platinum albums recorded by various notable musicians. The estate spans over 10 acres, providing privacy and ample outdoor space for inspiration and relaxation.

stories.title: In just one week, how security forces avenged attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam
Rare dinosaur discovery: Palaeontologists may uncover new dinosaur species; fossil from Utah to be studied in Raleigh's Dino Lab
stories.summary: The North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences in Raleigh is buzzing with excitement over a rare dinosaur skeleton recently acquired. Dating back 75 million years, and reminiscent of a large ostrich, this find from Utah could represent a new species, subject to further investigation. Visitors have the unique opportunity to view live research in the Dino Lab, offering insights into the diversity of dinosaurs from this area.

stories.title: Caltech robot revolutionizes space: Caltech robot builds structure in space; Space assembly showcases future construction possibilities
stories.summary: A robot developed by researchers at California Institute of Technology constructed a segment of a space structure autonomously. The assembly occurred as part of DARPA's NOM4D programme, testing innovative techniques for space construction. The Autonomous In-Space Tensioned Reflector Assembly robot utilized individual components to build an experimental antenna. Following the launch, the robot successfully coordinated with Earth-based commands to assemble its structure in orbit.

stories.title: NMC asks medical colleges to vet draft rules seeking tighter checks on animal experiments
stories.summary: The National Medical Commission has introduced new draft rules to enhance the ethical treatment of laboratory animals in research. Emphasizing the importance of alternative methods, researchers must prioritize minimizing animal suffering and avoid experiments that could result in prolonged distress. Furthermore, institutions are mandated to appoint veterinarians and form ethics committees to supervise the research. Any breaches could result in significant repercussions, including the potential revocation of registrations.

stories.title: 'Responsibility to banish hatred': Mamdani condemns anti-Indian racism at Diwali event
stories.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani addressed rising incidents of racism targeting the Indian-American community during a Diwali celebration. He emphasized the need for collective responsibility in combating hate and ensuring safety for Hindus and Sikhs. Thirteen US lawmakers have requested a federal investigation into a disruption of a Diwali event in Seattle. They referred to troubling patterns of anti-South Asian hate across the country.

stories.title: MacKenzie Scott donated $26 billion freely; four donors put $189 million into named institutes
Supreme Court issues contempt notice to lawyer over remarks against CJI Surya Kant
'Big potential benefit': Putin backs trilateral talks with Trump, Xi on APEC sidelines
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin expects substantial benefits from the upcoming trilateral meeting with US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping. The discussions are set to occur during the Apec summit in Shenzhen, China. Putin aims to strengthen Russia's diplomatic position while addressing the war in Ukraine. However, there are differing agendas that could complicate the talks, particularly regarding nuclear disarmament.

stories.title: BJP calls Rahul Gandhi 'Mir Jafar of India' over his remarks on economy in US
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi's recent remarks at Columbia University regarding India's economy have drawn criticism from BJP leaders. While he mentioned an impending economic disaster and unemployment issues, BJP officials accused him of spreading anti-India propaganda. They highlighted discrepancies between his views and positive economic indicators such as GDP growth and reduced unemployment rates. BJP spokespersons emphasized the need for leaders to represent India positively abroad.

stories.title: South African boy’s stay in England leads to year-long legal battle over his return
Cornered in a mosque, said 'no' to surrender: How forces killed LeT commander Lateef Bhat
Ankita Bhandari case: Parents demand Vinod Arya's narco test, call details from night of murder
'Some dishes best served cold': Top LeT commander Lateef Bhat killed in Kulgam encounter
India ranks 10th in Climate Risk Index, with 78,000 deaths and $170 billion in losses from 436 extreme weather events over 1996–2025
'Again, I wasn't heard': Bilkis to fight SC order giving bail to 2 convicts
stories.summary: The Supreme Court suspended the life sentences of and granted bail to two of 11 men convicted of gang-raping her and killing 14 of her family in the 2002 Gujarat riots.

stories.title: Pakistani man gets 27 years in US jail for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
stories.summary: A Pakistani man, Asif Merchant, was sentenced to 330 months in prison in the US for plotting to assassinate President Donald Trump and other prominent politicians at Iran's behest in 2024. Prosecutors said the plot was planned in retaliation for the 2020 killing of Iranian commander Qassem Soleimani. Merchant was convicted in March, while the plot was foiled before any attack took place.

stories.title: Jennifer Lopez unveils renovated $17.5m California estate after her divorce
stories.summary: Jennifer Lopez has recently transformed her Hidden Hills estate into a stylish sanctuary after her high-profile divorce. The property features carefully curated interiors, including a newly designed living room and renovated outdoor spaces. She hosted family and friends at her estate for a Memorial Day gathering, showcasing her new lifestyle. With five en-suite bedrooms and a guesthouse, the residence accommodates visitors comfortably.

stories.title: Fresh encounter breaks out in J&K's Kulgam
stories.summary: In Kulgam, Jammu and Kashmir, a recent skirmish erupted between security forces and terrorists, ignited by a preceding assault on a CRPF checkpoint that left three personnel injured. Investigations pinpointed Umar Nisar Dar and Lashkar-e-Taiba leader Lateef Bhat, who scouted potential targets ahead of the November 11 strike. Security forces clashed with Dar post-the Akhran incident, leading to his demise, while the search for Bhat persists amidst area operations.

stories.title: Indiana farmer not liable after crop-spraying drone struck Lonnie Howard in 2024
stories.summary: An incident involving an agricultural drone on a farm in Indiana led to a significant legal dispute. Lonnie Howard claimed injuries when the drone collided with his arm during a spraying operation. stories.summary: The lawyer was angry because a petition filed by him was yet listed despite intimation being given to CJI' Surya Kant's office. Some bar members later met the CJI requesting him to initiate contempt proceedings against the lawyer.

stories.title: Tour Raises $8.5 Million: The Weeknd’s run sets male solo-artist revenue record; $3 million raised in 2026
stories.summary: The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour achieved unprecedented success, wrapping up in 2026 with an impressive $8.5 million raised for charitable causes. Spanning 67 cities across five continents, the tour drew over nine million fans, setting the record for the highest-grossing concert tour by a male artist, overtaking Elton John's previous milestone.

stories.summary: The ministry of culture plans to give shape to a provenance mission for antiquities wherein an artifact's ownership and collection history is traced back to its place of origin.

stories.title: Dancing girl of Mohenjo-Daro to find new home in North Block museum next year
stories.summary: Several objects are likely to be moved from the National Museum to the ‘Adornment’ gallery. Visitors will be able to see ancient gold and gem-studded jewellery from Taxila (Taksasila) currently placed at the National Museum.

stories.title: Illinois appeals court upholds $7.5 million award in baby's childbirth death malpractice case
stories.summary: In a significant ruling, an Illinois appeals court upheld a $7.5 million wrongful-death verdict for the Flores family, stemming from medical negligence during childbirth at Advocate Illinois Masonic Medical Center. The court confirmed that juror consensus on negligence and its consequences was sufficient, thus clarifying standards in medical negligence cases. This judgement offers solace to the Flores family and underscores the critical need for prompt medical care.

stories.title: Microsoft asked him to go back to India after his H-1B visa was rejected. Kunal Bahl returned, but to build Snapdeal, Titan Capital
Brandi Carlile's charity surpasses $10m in grants, earning 2026 award recognition for its impact
stories.summary: At the 2026 Anthem Awards, Brandi Carlile shines as the Entertainer of the Year, celebrating a remarkable achievement for her Looking Out Foundation, which recently surpassed $10 million in grants to diverse charitable organizations. With a focus on uplifting LGBTQIA2S+ communities, the foundation inspires fans to donate small amounts, emphasizing that even an average contribution of $25 can create significant change.

stories.title: California's Shiv Durga Hindu temple reports another break-in; Republican leader tells Ro Khanna: It's your constituency...what are you doing?
Oprah joins Australian charity drive, packing care bag as campaign targets 150,000 donations
stories.summary: Oprah Winfrey is lending her support to Share the Dignity’s charity initiative by assembling care bags for women in need. This campaign, which runs from November 6 to November 22, 2026, across Australia, aims to gather 150,000 bags filled with essential items and uplifting notes. These care bags will benefit women struggling with homelessness or domestic violence. Donations are accepted at various Bunnings stores or online throughout the campaign duration.

stories.title: Two live snakes found inside passenger's suitcase at California airport: 'When I realized the item in my hand was alive...'
UK man wins Argos laptop refund battle after court rules activating Windows 11 does not cancel rights
stories.summary: A landmark court decision has established that buyers can return items purchased online within 14 days of receiving them. A University of Leicester professor successfully challenged retail titan Argos over the return of a laptop. The Court of Appeal ruled that activating pre-installed software does not forfeit the right to a refund. This ruling enhances consumer protection for electronics in the UK, prompting retailers to rethink their return policies.

stories.title: US stalker ordered to pay $18.6 million after stealing woman's Verizon records with fake warrant
stories.summary: In a landmark ruling, a federal judge in North Carolina has ordered convicted stalker Robert Michael Glauner to pay $18.632 million to a victim for the emotional trauma inflicted upon her. This judgment, which includes punitive damages, stems from Glauner's harassment after he unlawfully procured her private information with a forged search warrant. He was apprehended while attempting to confront her and remains incarcerated.

US aviation shutdown leaves four major airlines facing a $345 million hit after 18,500 cancellations
stories.summary: On November 13, 2026, the aviation sector faced a massive disruption as over 18,500 flights were canceled across the United States. This chaos was triggered by the Federal Aviation Administration's ground stop due to a malfunction with aging communications technology. Major airlines, particularly American Airlines and JetBlue, struggled the most. Passengers experienced extended wait times and were eligible for refunds.
